title: Meghalaya: Ropeway meeting descends into chaos; Minister says political hand behind protest

ai.summary: Meghalaya teachers in deficit schools and colleges have been protesting for over a week demanding the government address their recruitment issues, as the state's Centralised Fund Scheme 2026 has not been implemented.

facts.claim: Meghalaya teachers in deficit schools and colleges reject the state's Centralised Fund Scheme 2026
facts.quote: Staff of Meghalaya's deficit schools and colleges reject the state's Centralised Fund Scheme 2026.

facts.claim: The protest entered its fifth day on Wednesday
facts.quote: The protest entered its fifth day on Wednesday, with demonstrators demanding that the proposed ropeway project either be scrapped or shifted to another location.

ai.background_note: The Meghalaya teachers' protest over the Centralised Fund Scheme 2026 has escalated into a sit-in demonstration demanding the government address their recruitment issues.
